description: Source code for a disk cache memory test utility, including functions for cache backend creation, memory analysis, and command-line interface handling.

classes.name: CacheSpec
classes.description: Represents cache configuration parameters parsed from a spec string, including backend type, cache type, and file path.

methods.name: CacheSpec::Parse
methods.description: Parses a cache specification string into a CacheSpec object.

methods.name: SetSuccessCodeOnCompletion
methods.description: Sets a success flag based on the net error code and quits the run loop.

methods.name: CreateAndInitBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cache backend based on the CacheSpec.

methods.name: ParseRangeLine
methods.description: Parses a line from /proc/<PID>/smaps to determine memory range properties.

methods.name: ParseRangeProperty
methods.description: Parses a range property line from /proc/<PID>/smaps to extract size and dirty memory info.

methods.name: GetMemoryConsumption
methods.description: Calculates total private dirty memory usage by reading /proc/<PID>/smaps.

methods.name: CacheMemTest
methods.description: Performs memory testing on a list of cache specifications, outputs entry counts and memory usage.

methods.name: PrintUsage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the command-line utility.

methods.name: ParseAndStoreSpec
methods.description: Parses a cache spec string and stores it in the specs vector.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main entry point for the disk cache memory test utility, handles command-line arguments and initiates tests.
